properties.title: SurgGMF: Fully Causal Gaussian Motion Forecasting for Anticipatory Surgical Scene Rendering

membership.reason: SurgGMF forecasts future 3D Gaussian surgical scene states (position, scale, rotation residuals) over a 5-step horizon under a strict causal rendering boundary.
membership.counting_boundary: Verified L1 causal surgical scene forecasting world model (WT_PROCEDURE, BP_FORECAST).

properties.backbone: Deform3DGS state space + interchangeable temporal learners (TKAN, GRU, LSTM, Transformer) + full-causal-last 3DGS renderer

properties.flow: H=10 Gaussian X/S/R motion history -> temporal learner -> P=5 predicted Gaussian states -> full-causal-last RGB frame rendering

properties.purpose: Short-horizon anticipatory 3D surgical scene forecasting and rendering.
properties.environment: 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS surgical video slices

assertions.rationale: Full-causal-last rendering protocol prevents target-frame Gaussian attribute leakage.
ID-aligned 3D Gaussian scene primitives G^t = {(x, s, r, alpha, c)}.
Conditioned on H=10 historical X/S/R Gaussian motion fields.
Multi-step (P=5) future Gaussian motion residual forecasting.
Neural temporal learners (TKAN, GRU, LSTM, Transformer) in 3D Gaussian residual space.
3D Gaussian splatting renderer generating future RGB frames.

Evaluated future-frame render-space forecasting across 5 prediction steps (P=5) over 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS video slices (1,165 valid frame-horizon pairs, Table 2 & Figure 3); all four neural learners (TKAN PSNR 31.895, SSIM 0.8633, LPIPS 0.1764, MAE 0.0172; LSTM; GRU; Transformer) exceed classical dynamics baselines on every evaluated metric.
Anticipatory surgical scene rendering for robotic perception and decision support.
5-step future render-space forecasting outperforming classical dynamics baselines.
Evaluated across 12 slices from EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets.
Module-level latency vs accuracy trade-off analyzed (TKAN highest accuracy, GRU/LSTM lowest latency).

evidence_fragments.content: To this end, we present SurgGMF, a fully causal Gaussian motion forecasting framework for anticipatory surgical scene rendering. Rather than predicting future RGB images directly, SurgGMF forecasts future Gaussian motion states represented by position, scale, and rotation residuals (X/S/R) from historical Gaussian motion fields. To prevent target leakage, we introduce a full-causal-last rendering protocol, where future Gaussian states are rendered without accessing target-frame Gaussian attributes while preserving causal appearance propagation. We evaluate SurgGMF on 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS video slices using neural temporal learners and classical dynamics baselines under a unified forecasting protocol.

Figure 1: Overview of SurgGMF. A trained Deform3DGS teacher exports temporally aligned Gaussian states. SurgGMF constructs X/S/R motion histories, forecasts future Gaussian motion states with a temporal learner or a dynamics baseline, converts predicted residuals back into future Gaussian states, and evaluates rendered future frames under the full-causal-last protocol.

Each neural learner exceeds the corresponding best classical score on every evaluated metric. Relative to the metric-wise best classical scores, the neural models improve PSNR by 0.983–1.204 dB and SSIM by 0.0242–0.0290, while reducing LPIPS by 0.0040–0.0054 and MAE by 0.0025–0.0031.

capability_assessments.rationale: Causal 3D Gaussian motion residual forecasting (P=5 steps) for anticipatory surgical rendering without action conditioning (L1).

limitations: Unconditioned short-horizon motion forecasting (no robotic action conditioning); teacher-derived Gaussian states.
notes: All 16 physical PDF pages extracted/read; page 4 visually inspected via rendered PNG.

legacy_cells.B: SurgGMF: Fully Causal Gaussian Motion Forecasting for Anticipatory Surgical Scene Rendering
legacy_cells.S: Can a short history of surgical Gaussian motion states forecast future scene geometry well enough to render future surgical frames without target-frame Gaussian attributes?
legacy_cells.T: 12 surgical video slices from EndoNeRF and StereoMIS: one cutting sequence, one pulling sequence, and ten StereoMIS temporal segments.
legacy_cells.AI: Per-Gaussian X/S/R motion-residual time series (16 channels, including position-derived velocity and acceleration)
legacy_cells.BL: 10-frame history and 5-frame prediction horizon; approximately 0.25–0.33 seconds of history and 0.125–0.167 seconds of future at 30–40 FPS.
legacy_cells.BS: Forecast future Gaussian position, scale, and rotation residuals; construct Gaussian scene states and render future frames.
legacy_cells.BV: Attribute-wise weighted mean-squared error over position, scale, and rotation residuals; weights wx=1.0, ws=0.25, wr=0.25.
legacy_cells.CA: Training used an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU.
legacy_cells.CB: Model-only FP32 latency per batch of 10,000 Gaussian trajectories: GRU 5.94 ms; LSTM 8.25 ms; Transformer 27.99 ms; TKAN 3,530 ms. Forecast–render latency/FPS: GRU 35.08 ms/28.5 FP32 and 18.14 ms/55.1 AMP; LSTM 46.67 ms/21.4 FP32 and 24.05 ms/41.6 AMP; Transformer 151.99 ms/6.6 FP32 and 71.66 ms/14.0 AMP.
legacy_cells.DQ: 12 surgical video slices; 1,165 legal frame–horizon pairs per forecasting method; 10,485 rendered predictions across nine methods.
legacy_cells.EG: Model-only forecasting latency: GRU 5.94 ms, LSTM 8.25 ms, Transformer 27.99 ms, TKAN 3,530 ms; forecast–render throughput also measured (GRU 28.5 FPS FP32 / 55.1 FPS AMP; LSTM 21.4 / 41.6 FPS; Transformer 6.6 / 14.0 FPS).
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with persistence, constant velocity, linear fit, constant acceleration, and Kalman-CV. Best neural result (TKAN): PSNR 31.895, SSIM 0.8633, LPIPS 0.1764, MAE 0.0172; best classical scores were constant-velocity PSNR 30.691, SSIM 0.8343, MAE 0.0203, and persistence LPIPS 0.1818.
legacy_cells.EK: Forecast-target ablation in LSTM and TKAN: position only (X), X+scale (X+S), X+rotation (X+R), and joint X+S+R. Joint X+S+R performed best; relative to X-only, PSNR improved by 1.240 dB for LSTM and 1.325 dB for TKAN.
legacy_cells.EL: The authors report that preliminary appearance-forecasting diagnostics were unsatisfactory; the formal study therefore forecasts geometry only.
legacy_cells.FL: A trained Deform3DGS teacher exports temporally aligned Gaussian states; the pipeline constructs X/S/R histories, forecasts the five-step future with GRU, LSTM, TKAN, Transformer, or classical dynamics, reconstructs Gaussian states, and renders under full-causal-last attribute propagation. No planner is implemented.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces a full-causal-last protocol for forecasting future surgical Gaussian motion states without target-frame Gaussian attributes, and benchmarks neural temporal learners against controlled classical dynamics baselines.
legacy_cells.FN: Across 12 surgical video slices, TKAN attained average PSNR 31.895, SSIM 0.8633, LPIPS 0.1764, and MAE 0.0172; learned methods outperformed the best classical score on each evaluated metric. TKAN model-only latency was 3,530 ms, while GRU and LSTM were faster (5.94 ms and 8.25 ms).
legacy_cells.FO: The authors state that the study focuses on short-horizon geometry forecasting and module-level evaluation; the reported FPS excludes upstream and system-level operations and is not end-to-end robotic-system real-time performance.
legacy_cells.FP: Extend to longer-horizon forecasting, joint geometry–appearance prediction, and end-to-end online deployment.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify a gap between observed-frame surgical reconstruction and forecasting future surgical Gaussian states under a fixed historical observation boundary and strict target-frame isolation.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports short-horizon, retrospective surgical-scene geometry forecasting and render-space fidelity only. No treatment/procedural action conditioning, causal intervention identification, alternative-action counterfactuals, planning, decision-quality evaluation, prospective validation, or end-to-end deployment is demonstrated; 'causal' denotes target-frame leakage prevention, not causal treatment-effect identification.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
